summary: Validated the requested MathBlitz pacing, attribution, Instagram control, timer, level-up deduction, and core mobile gameplay flow against the public preview; backend regression also passed.
critical_code_review_comments: No new blocking issues found in the referenced feature code. Instagram uses React Native Linking.openURL; Expo web does not expose an href, but the accessible control and configured target were verified.
seed_data_creation: Backend regression created and deleted a TEST_ question and created a TEST_ challenge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public mobile preview verified six age pacing cards, presenter attribution, Instagram accessibility target, gameplay timer countdown, level 1 pressure label, three correct-answer progression, level 2 label, and −1s level-up deduction. No APIs are used by gameplay; no mocked APIs were introduced.
rca_of_issue: Two initial automation attempts failed due to test-script locator/parser ambiguity: substring matching Answer 1 matched Answer 19/17/18, and a broad question regex matched the benchmark text. The final scoped question locator and exact answer role selector passed; these were test issues, not app findings.
